library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
# Helper function to embed PDF as image
embed_pdf <- function(pdf_path, width = "100%") {
  if (!file.exists(pdf_path)) {
    return(paste0("**File not found:** `", basename(pdf_path), "`"))
  }
  if (requireNamespace("pdftools", quietly = TRUE)) {
    png_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    tryCatch({
      pdftools::pdf_convert(pdf_path, format = "png", pages = 1, 
                            filenames = png_path, dpi = 150, verbose = FALSE)
      knitr::include_graphics(png_path)
    }, error = function(e) {
      paste0("**Error converting PDF:** `", basename(pdf_path), "`")
    })
  } else {
    paste0("[PDF: ", basename(pdf_path), "](", pdf_path, ")")
  }
}
# Helper function to embed image
embed_image <- function(img_path, width = "100%") {
  if (!file.exists(img_path)) {
    return(paste0("**File not found:** `", basename(img_path), "`"))
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(img_path)
}
# Helper function to check file existence
file_status <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) "Done" else "Missing"
}
# Helper function to parse 01d log for positive/negative control results
parse_01d_log <- function(log_file) {
  if (!file.exists(log_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  lines <- readLines(log_file, warn = FALSE)
  results <- list()
  current_cpg <- NULL
  current_type <- NULL
  current_chr <- NULL
  current_pos <- NULL
  
  for (i in seq_along(lines)) {
    line <- lines[i]
    
    # Detect positive control
    if (grepl("Processing positive control:", line)) {
      current_type <- "positive"
      current_cpg <- sub(".*control: (cg[0-9]+),.*", "\\1", line)
      current_chr <- sub(".*SNP chr: ([0-9]+),.*", "\\1", line)
      current_pos <- sub(".*pos: ([0-9]+),.*", "\\1", line)
      results[[current_cpg]] <- list(type = current_type, chr = current_chr, pos = current_pos)
    }
    
    # Detect negative control
    if (grepl("Processing negative control:", line)) {
      current_type <- "negative"
      current_cpg <- sub(".*control: (NEG_cg[0-9]+).*", "\\1", line)
      results[[current_cpg]] <- list(type = current_type)
    }
    
    # Extract lowest p-value (positive controls only)
    if (grepl("Lowest p-value within", line) && !is.null(current_cpg)) {
      pval <- sub(".*: ([0-9.e+-]+).*", "\\1", line)
      results[[current_cpg]]$pvalue <- pval
    }
    
    # Extract lambda (use nocisChr version for positive controls)
    if (grepl("with lambda", line) && !is.null(current_cpg)) {
      lambda <- sub(".*with lambda ([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", line)
      if (grepl("nocisChr", line) || current_type == "negative") {
        results[[current_cpg]]$lambda <- lambda
      } else if (is.null(results[[current_cpg]]$lambda)) {
        # Use regular lambda if nocisChr not available
        results[[current_cpg]]$lambda <- lambda
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(results) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Convert to data.frame
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results), function(cpg) {
    r <- results[[cpg]]
    data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Type = r$type,
      Chr = ifelse(is.null(r$chr), NA, r$chr),
      Pos = ifelse(is.null(r$pos), NA, r$pos),
      Min_Pvalue = ifelse(is.null(r$pvalue), NA, r$pvalue),
      Lambda = ifelse(is.null(r$lambda), NA, r$lambda),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}
# Define paths
home_dir <- params$home_directory
section_01 <- params$section_01_dir
processed_data <- file.path(home_dir, "processed_data")
Configuration Summary {.tabset}
Study Information
config_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Study Name", "Ancestry", "Genome Build", "Methylation Chip", 
                "Number of Genetic PCs", "Number of HCs"),
  Value = c(params$study_name, params$ancestry, params$genome_build, 
            params$meth_chip, params$n_pcs, params$n_hcs)
)
kable(config_df, col.names = c("Parameter", "Value")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
Directory Structure
dir_df <- data.frame(
  Directory = c("Home Directory", "Results (01)", "Processed Data"),
  Path = c(home_dir, section_01, processed_data),
  Status = c(
    ifelse(dir.exists(home_dir), "Exists", "Missing"),
    ifelse(dir.exists(section_01), "Exists", "Missing"),
    ifelse(dir.exists(processed_data), "Exists", "Missing")
  )
)
kable(dir_df) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

01a: Data Check {.tabset}
Cohort Descriptives
cohort_desc_file <- file.path(section_01, "cohort_descriptives.RData")
if (file.exists(cohort_desc_file)) {
  load(cohort_desc_file)
  
  desc_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Genotype Sample Size",
      "Number of SNPs",
      "Mean Imputation Info",
      "Mean MAF",
      "Number of CpGs",
      "Methylation Sample Size",
      "Common Sample Size (Geno + Meth)",
      "Measured Cell Counts"
    ),
    Value = c(
      cohort_summary$geno_sample_size,
      cohort_summary$n_snp,
      round(cohort_summary$mean_info, 4),
      round(cohort_summary$mean_maf, 4),
      cohort_summary$n_CpGs,
      cohort_summary$methylation_sample_size,
      cohort_summary$geno_meth_common_ids,
      cohort_summary$measured_cellcounts
    )
  )
  
  kable(desc_df, col.names = c("Metric", "Value")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("**cohort_descriptives.RData not found**")
}
SNPs by Chromosome

01d: mQTL Controls {.tabset}
Summary Table
log_01d <- file.path(section_01, "logs_d", "log.txt")
control_results <- parse_01d_log(log_01d)
if (!is.null(control_results) && nrow(control_results) > 0) {
  # Format the table
  control_results$Min_Pvalue <- ifelse(is.na(control_results$Min_Pvalue), "-", control_results$Min_Pvalue)
  control_results$Lambda <- ifelse(is.na(control_results$Lambda), "-", round(as.numeric(control_results$Lambda), 4))
  control_results$Chr <- ifelse(is.na(control_results$Chr), "-", control_results$Chr)
  control_results$Pos <- ifelse(is.na(control_results$Pos), "-", control_results$Pos)
  
  kable(control_results, 
        col.names = c("CpG", "Type", "Chr", "Position", "Min P-value", "Lambda (no cis)")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(which(control_results$Type == "positive"), background = "#d4edda") %>%
    row_spec(which(control_results$Type == "negative"), background = "#fff3cd")
} else {
  cat("**01d log not found or no control results parsed**")
}
Positive Control Manhattan Plots
dir_01d <- file.path(section_01, "01d")
if (dir.exists(dir_01d)) {
  pos_manhattans <- list.files(dir_01d, pattern = "positive_control.*_manhattan\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
  pos_manhattans <- pos_manhattans[!grepl("nocisChr", pos_manhattans)]
  
  if (length(pos_manhattans) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(min(5, length(pos_manhattans)))) {
      cpg_name <- sub(".*positive_control_untransformed_(cg[0-9]+)_manhattan\\.pdf", "\\1", basename(pos_manhattans[i]))
      cat(paste0("\n\n### ", cpg_name, "\n\n"))
      print(embed_pdf(pos_manhattans[i]))
    }
  } else {
    cat("**No positive control Manhattan plots found**")
  }
} else {
  cat("**01d directory not found**")
}
Positive Control QQ Plots

01e: Genetic PC GWAS {.tabset}
Manhattan Plots
dir_01e <- file.path(section_01, "01e")
if (dir.exists(dir_01e)) {
  pc_manhattans <- list.files(dir_01e, pattern = "gwas_PC[0-9]+_manhattan\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(pc_manhattans) > 0) {
    # Sort by PC number
    pc_nums <- as.numeric(sub(".*gwas_PC([0-9]+)_manhattan\\.pdf", "\\1", basename(pc_manhattans)))
    pc_manhattans <- pc_manhattans[order(pc_nums)]
    
    for (plot_file in pc_manhattans[1:min(5, length(pc_manhattans))]) {
      pc_name <- sub("_manhattan\\.pdf$", "", basename(plot_file))
      cat(paste0("\n\n### ", pc_name, "\n\n"))
      print(embed_pdf(plot_file))
    }
  } else {
    cat("**No PC GWAS Manhattan plots found**")
  }
} else {
  cat("**01e directory not found**")
}
---
01f: Normalization
log_01f <- file.path(section_01, "logs_f")
normalization_success <- FALSE
if (dir.exists(log_01f)) {
  log_files <- list.files(log_01f, pattern = "log.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(log_files) > 0) {
    latest_log <- log_files[order(file.mtime(log_files), decreasing = TRUE)[1]]
    log_content <- readLines(latest_log, warn = FALSE)
    
    if (any(grepl("Shrunk QC objects created", log_content, ignore.case = FALSE))) {
      normalization_success <- TRUE
      cat("**Status:** Shrunk QC objects created successfully\n\n")
    } else {
      cat("**Status:** Normalization may not have completed - 'Shrunk QC objects created' not found in log\n\n")
    }
    
    cat(paste0("Log file: `", basename(latest_log), "`\n"))
  } else {
    cat("**No log files found in logs_f**\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("**01f logs directory not found - step may not have been run**\n")
}
# Check for output file
norm_output <- file.path(home_dir, "processed_data", "methylation_data", "normalized_between_datasets.Robj")

                              pattern = ".*shrunk.*\\.Robj$", ignore.case = TRUE)

    cat(paste0("- `", f, "`\n"))
  }
}

Step Completion Summary
steps <- data.frame(
  Step = c("01a", "01b", "01c", "01d", "01e", "01f", "01g"),
  Description = c(
    "Data Check",
    "Genetic Data Processing", 
    "Phenotypes & Methylation",
    "mQTL Controls",
    "Genetic PC GWAS",
    "Normalization",
    "Haplotype Components"
  ),
  Status = c(
    file_status(file.path(section_01, "cohort_descriptives.RData")),
    file_status(file.path(section_01, "pcaplot.pdf")),
    file_status(file.path(section_01, "cohort_descriptives_was.RData")),
    ifelse(dir.exists(file.path(section_01, "01d")), "Done", "Missing"),
    ifelse(dir.exists(file.path(section_01, "01e")), "Done", "Missing"),
    ifelse(length(list.files(file.path(home_dir, "processed_data", "methylation_data"), 
                              pattern = "shrunk", ignore.case = TRUE)) > 0, "Done", "Missing"),
    file_status(file.path(section_01, "hcs_kernel.pdf"))
  )
)
kable(steps) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(which(steps$Status == "Done"), background = "#d4edda") %>%
  row_spec(which(steps$Status == "Missing"), background = "#f8d7da")
